sentences.text: Heard Mr. Amar Murti Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. Tumul Nainwal, learned Assistant Government Advocate for the respondents.
3. Mr. Amar Murti Shukla, Advocate, contended that in the scholarship scam matter, a charge-sheet has been filed against the present applicant and four others.
The allegation against the present applicant is that he disbursed the scholarship without any physical verification of the concerned students.
The said allegation is totally false.
The institute-in- question was located outside the State of Uttarakhand and at that time, there was no provision of physical verification of the concerned student.
The applicant, the then District Social Welfare Officer, Udham Singh Nagar, was at no fault in the process of disbursement of the scholarship.
4. Mr. Tumul Nainwal, Assistant Government Advocate, has sought three weeks' time to file counter affidavit.
Till then, the further proceedings of the said Special Sessions Trial No.21 of 2023 are stayed qua the applicant Jagmohan Singh Kafola.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 05.01.2026 Shiv/
